intents.trigger: Confirmed daily close below $14.20 on rising volume (short-side probe only)
intents.entry_convention: Short probe after volume-confirmed daily close below $14.20; add only after the $13.30-13.85 shelf breaks. Longs explicitly forbidden; push toward $16.20 is a distribution zone, not a breakout entry.
intents.invalidation: Hard stop above $14.97 (10 EMA reclaim); a decisive close above $16.20 on expanding volume invalidates the bear posture entirely
intents.horizon: 1-2 quarters (until the liquidity event — buyback halt or capital raise — resolves)
intents.reevaluation: Revisit if Q3 shows genuine gross margin recovery, operating cash flow repeats Q2's level, and buyback is paused without a capital raise; or on decisive close above $16.20
intents.ambiguity: Short-only plan, contingent on short exposure being permitted; stated size is a range of 3-5% of portfolio notional (~$3,000-5,000), recorded at the 5% cap. Trigger requires a confirmed daily close, not an executable intraday/limit order.
